author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) to start rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Brendan Donovan will begin a rehab assignment on Tuesday.
impact: Donovan has been sidelined on the injured list since the middle of May. He'll look to return shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock to start Sunday
desc: Emerson Hancock will start Sunday's series finale against the Blue Jays.
impact: Hancock was originally scheduled to piggyback behind Logan Gilbert on Saturday. It will instead be Gilbert on Saturday and Hancock on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Gilbert to draw normal start Saturday
desc: Logan Gilbert will make a normal start on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: There will be no more piggyback. Gilbert will start on Saturday with Emerson Hancock starting Sunday's series finale.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Molina optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Braves optioned Anthony Molina to Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Molina will return to Triple-A with JR Ritchie getting called back up as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Farmer (forearm) activated from IL
desc: The Braves activated Kyle Farmer from the injured list.
impact: Farmer returns from a rehab assignment he was on for close to two weeks. Ha-Seong Kim was placed on the IL as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Braves recalled JR Ritchie from Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Ritchie was scratched from his scheduled start in Triple-A to get the call back to the majors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) placed on IL
desc: The Braves placed Ha-Seong Kim on the injured list with right middle finger inflammation.
impact: Kim will be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks through the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dom Keegan sent outright by Orioles
desc: Dom Keegan cleared outright waivers and has been assigned to Double-A Chesapeake.
impact: Keegan went unclaimed on waivers after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Orioles organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Cavalli to start Sunday
desc: Cade Cavalli will now start on Sunday against the Pirates.
impact: Cavalli was initially slated to start on Monday against the Astros. He is currently appealing a seven-game suspension that he received from the MLB.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jalen Beeks (flexor) out for the season
desc: Rangers left-hander Jalen Beeks (flexor) is out for the season after undergoing surgery.
impact: Beeks has been on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms, but it now appears he has undergone flexor tendon surgery on his left arm and will miss the remainder of the season. The southpaw posted a 3.81 ERA in 29 appearances for the club this season prior to hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jakob Junis (hip) placed on IL, hoping for minimum stay
desc: Rangers right-hander Jacob Junis (hip) has been placed on the 15-day injured list, but the expectation is a minimum stay.
impact: Junis also received an injection in his ailing hip, which the team hopes will help limit his absence to the minimum 15 days. The 33-year-old has been used in several roles this season and has thrived with a 2.80 ERA across 31 appearances, also locking down five saves in the process.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Chris Martin (shoulder) activated from injured list
desc: The Rangers have activated right-hander Chris Martin (shoulder) from the
impact: Martin was placed on the IL on June 1 due to a right shoulder impingement and pitched a scoreless inning for Double-A Frisco on July 1. The veteran limped to a 7.84 ERA in 12 starts prior to hitting the shelf, but he also worked to a stellar 2.98 ERA across 49 appearances a season ago.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Chase Petty optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Reds have optioned right-hander Chase Petty to Triple-A Louisville.
impact: The Reds needed to clear an active roster spot for the return of right-hander Hunter Greene (elbow) from the injured list on Saturday, and it's Petty heading down to Louisville. The 23-year-old has posted a 4.37 ERA across 10 outings (two starts) for the Reds this season in addition to a 6.17 ERA in 10 starts for Louisville.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Will Benson designated for assignment
desc: The Reds have designated outfielder Will Benson for assignment.
impact: The Reds needed to clear a 40-man roster spot for the return of Hunter Greene (elbow) from the injured list, costing Benson his spot in the process. The 28-year-old has struggled this season, hitting just .188 with three homers, a stolen base, and a .643 OPS across 114 trips to the plate.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Hunter Greene (elbow) officially activated from IL
desc: The Reds have activated right-hander Hunter Greene (elbow) from the 60-day injured list.
impact: Greene will make his long-awaited 2026 debut on Saturday when he takes on the Orioles at home. The flame-throwing right-hander underwent right elbow surgery on March 11 to remove loose bodies and pitched 14 1/3 scoreless innings across three rehab starts prior to his activation. Greene posted a 2.76 ERA along with a 0.94 WHIP and a 132:26 K:BB across 19 starts and 107 2/3 innings last season.
